source_text: Sara risit in corde. Numquid Domino est difficile? Annuntiatur Isaac — risus fidei et temptationis incredulitatis.
pass_a_gloss: Sarah laughed in heart. Whether to-Lord is difficult? Is-announced Isaac — laughter of-faith and of-temptation of-unbelief.
pass_b_english: [[Sarah laughed in her heart >> Bible:Genesis 18:12]]. [[Is anything too hard for the Lord? >> Bible:Genesis 18:14]] Isaac is announced — laughter of faith and the trial of unbelief.
